data.case_title: Rechnung Gartenbau Beispiel GmbH – Heckenpflege/Rasenschnitt Juli 2026
data.explanation: This is an invoice (Rechnung) from a gardening company for hedge trimming and lawn care done in July 2026. The total amount of 773.50 EUR is due within 14 days of the invoice date, so payment should already have been sent by the deadline shown. If it hasn't been paid yet, transfer the amount now to the IBAN given, using the invoice number as reference, to avoid a reminder (Mahnung) or late fees. Keep this invoice, since costs for craftsman/gardening services can often be partly deducted in your German tax return (Handwerkerleistungen).
